entities.summary: Rowan Alexander Barrett Sr. is a Canadian former professional basketball player. At a height of 1.98 m tall, he played at the shooting guard and small forward positions. He was the top scorer in the 2002 Israel Basketball Premier League. He is general manager of the Canadian men's national team.
